extensionsMoved.title: Flux, Argo CD, Argo Rollouts and Argo Workflows are now extensions
extensionsMoved.text: Their views moved out of Sextant into its own extensions from the extension catalog, which are updated on their own. Install the ones you use below: until then their sections are not shown. Your notification settings for them were kept, and the sidebar also offers them in clusters that run these tools.

api4.title: Extension API 4
api4.text: Extensions can now have sidebar sections with Sextant's own tables, computed columns, one-click actions, services inside the cluster and tools for AI agents: enough to build these four views on the public API.

agentTools.title: GitOps tools for AI agents are now the extensions'
agentTools.text: The MCP tool gitops_action is gone: the Flux and Argo CD extensions give agents Reconcile, Suspend and Resume, and Sync, Refresh and Hard refresh. To let agents use them, turn on the extension's tools in Settings → AI agents (MCP).

extensions.title: Install the extensions that moved
extensions.hint: Each package is checked and asks for your consent before it is installed.
extensions.catalogOff: The extension catalog is turned off: turn it on in Settings → Extensions to install them.

about.flux: Sources, Kustomizations, HelmReleases, image automation and notifications
about.argo-cd: Applications with sync, health, resources, history and diff
about.argo-rollouts: Rollouts with steps, weights and analysis; promote, abort and pause
about.argo-workflows: Workflows with their step tree and logs, CronWorkflows and templates
